worldcombat.skill.bite.summary: A quick pounce and a hooked bite: the cheapest melee move in the family, with a chance to flinch and to reel the target back toward the user - its value is in tempo and holding a target close.
worldcombat.skill.bite.description.0: The bite deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block fang radius; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.bite.description.1: It pounces up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick; the first enemy it meets is bitten and dragged %3$s blocks back toward the user.
worldcombat.skill.bite.description.2: A solid bite has a %1$s chance to make the target flinch for %2$s: it first tries to interrupt its current interruptible action, and while flinching the target cannot start new moves or make ordinary attacks.
worldcombat.skill.bite.deep.on: Deep bite: bites harder, drags the target closer and flinches longer and more often, but winds up slower, hits slightly lighter and has a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.bite.deep.off: Quick bite: faster to cast and hits a little harder, but barely pulls the target.
worldcombat.skill.bite.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.bite.growth.0: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bite.growth.1: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s, the drag to %3$s blocks and the flinch chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.bite.use.0: Steal the tempo with the shortest-cooldown melee bite
worldcombat.skill.bite.use.1: Reel a target that is trying to open the distance back in
worldcombat.skill.bite.use.2: Hold a target close for the next melee move
worldcombat.skill.bite.preference.deep.h: On: bites harder, drags the target closer and flinches longer and more often, but winds up slower, hits slightly lighter and has a longer cooldown; good for keeping a target in front of you. Off: a quick bite - faster and a little harder, but barely pulls.
worldcombat.skill.bite.preference.ai.max: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger chases harder and more easily ends up beside the target after a whiff.
worldcombat.skill.bite.preference.ai.ree: On: prefer to bite targets that are opening the distance or that are not yet flinched, pulling them back. Off: sort bite as an ordinary melee move with no reel-in bonus.
